description: This file contains utility functions for handling direct URLs within the pip package manager, including conversion to requirement strings, creating editable URLs, and resolving URLs from link objects, with special handling for version control, archive, and directory URLs.

classes.name: DirectUrl
classes.description: Represents a direct URL with associated metadata, such as VCS info, archive info, or directory info.

classes.name: ArchiveInfo
classes.description: Metadata for archive URLs, including hash.

classes.name: DirInfo
classes.description: Metadata for directory URLs, including whether it is editable.

classes.name: VcsInfo
classes.description: Metadata for version control system URLs, including VCS type, commit ID, and requested revision.

classes.name: Link
classes.description: Represents a URL link with optional subdirectory and hash information.

methods.name: str direct_url_as_pep440_direct_reference(direct_url: DirectUrl, name: str)
methods.description: Converts a DirectUrl object to a PEP 440 requirement string.

methods.name: DirectUrl direct_url_for_editable(source_dir: str)
methods.description: Creates a DirectUrl for an editable source directory.

methods.name: DirectUrl direct_url_from_link( link: Link, source_dir: Optional[str] = None, link_is_in_wheel_cache: bool = False )
methods.description: Creates a DirectUrl object from a Link, resolving URLs for VCS, directory, or archive links.

ctags.name: direct_url_from_link
ctags.signature: ( link: Link, source_dir: Optional[str] = None, link_is_in_wheel_cache: bool = False )
